requirements_summary: Primary workload: customer support agent + ticket-deflection. Indexing target: ~200M documents (support articles + past tickets) initially, plan to grow to 600M. Embeddings: 1536–2048 dims (vector store), expect ~2–6 TB of vector storage. Retrieval pattern: low-latency fanout (top-100 ANN fetch) + cross-encoder reranker for top-5. Latency SLOs: p95 end-to-end <= 120ms (aim), p99 <= 300ms for agent flows; rerank stage must finish within 50–120ms to hit SLO. Cost target: <$0.0025 per query (at scale) for combined retrieval+rerank. Security: VPC peering, SAML SSO, KMS integration, audit logs + retention controls. Needs A/B evaluation of quantized model variants (FP16 vs 4-bit) to hit cost/latency tradeoffs.
